task_status_unchanged: PENDING (second validated slice; L2 acceptance not met)
blinding_note: The real NVSS dipole was NOT computed. Columns read: RA(2000), DEC(2000), PEAK INT. The catalogue's integral-count slope and a pixel-scatter comparison were computed.

inputs.flux_column_caveat: no integrated-flux column in this FITS; PEAK INT (Jy/beam) is used as a flux proxy for the count slope

integral_count_slope_x.meaning: x = -d ln N(>S)/d ln S for the footprint-cut catalogue (peak-flux proxy); bootstrap sd is statistical only, systematic from peak-vs-integrated flux not estimated

Ellis_Baldwin_amplitude_over_beta.note: D = [2 + x(1+alpha)] beta; alpha is NOT measurable from NVSS alone, so the response is a range over a declared alpha grid; the repository's hard-coded NVSS factors 3.50, 3.6625 and 3.75 correspond to alpha ~0.44, ~0.59 and ~0.68 for this x, i.e. they sit near the range but carry no derivation

synthetic_randoms.label: SYNTHETIC_RANDOM_CATALOGUE
synthetic_randoms.geometry: uniform inside dec>-37 deg and |b|>10 deg; no completeness, rms or blank-region modelling

catalogue_vs_synthetic_footprint.interpretation: modest excess over Poisson (about 1.1x): real structure and unmodelled footprint/rms variation; not a dipole and not separable here

estimator_validation_nside32_60_mocks.interpretation: no significant bias (max 1.8 standard errors in 9 components); scatter 2.4-4.5e-3 per axis, 0.7-1.3x the full-sky Poisson value; the standard error of a mean bias is ~4e-4 to 6e-4

claims.claim: NVSS integral count slope at 20-80 mJy (peak flux) is x = 1.043 +- 0.003 (stat).
claims.limit: peak flux proxy; footprint cut dec>-37, |b|>10; no completeness correction

claims.claim: Count-dipole kinematic response for NVSS is 3.56-4.09 beta over alpha 0.5-1.0.
claims.limit: alpha assumed on a grid; evolution/size/selection effects not included; replaces any point value

claims.claim: The Poisson-WLS estimator is unbiased on synthetic NVSS-footprint mocks at the ~5e-4 level.
claims.limit: mocks drawn from synthetic randoms with the same footprint; cannot test real-catalogue systematics

claims.claim: Real NVSS or RACS dipole measured.

not_run: authentic NVSS footprint/rms-based randoms (none exist as an official product)
next_gate: Combine tracers: define the joint kinematic estimand with Quaia and NVSS responses over the declared alpha grid, add declination-dependent NVSS systematics templates, then the RACS replication lane.
